summary: Tested all requested backend and desktop UI workflows. Core sourcing, scoring, stage gates, enrichment, VDR policy/versioning, agents, graph, gateway, and JSON-RPC flows passed. Backend error handling has 3 failures; mobile layout is unusable.

critical.issue: Accepts a nonexistent target_id and creates an orphan deal (HTTP 200) instead of rejecting it.

minor.issue: Updating a nonexistent contact returns HTTP 200 with null instead of 404.
Updating access for a nonexistent document returns HTTP 200 with null instead of 404.

issues: At 390px width the fixed 236px sidebar leaves only 154px for main content; headings, metrics, charts, and tables are severely clipped and unusable. Add a responsive collapsed/drawer navigation and mobile-safe content layout.

design_issues.screen: Create-target, create-deal, enrichment, and outreach dialogs
issues: Radix logs Missing Description/aria-describedby warnings; add DialogDescription or explicitly configure aria-describedby.

action_items: Validate that target_id exists before creating a deal and return a meaningful 404/422.
Check matched_count for contact and document-access updates; return 404 when absent.
Add accessible descriptions to Radix dialogs and missing data-testid attributes to select options/other interactive controls.
Retest error handling and responsive UI after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: create_deal persists arbitrary target_id values without referential validation; non-ObjectId strings can also break later ObjectId conversion in deal listing/detail flows.
update_contact and set_access ignore MongoDB matched_count and pass None through response serialization, producing misleading 200 null responses.
delete_document removes metadata but not its vdr_blobs object; repeated upload/delete leaks blob storage. Target/deal deletes similarly do not cascade or guard dependent records.
Most frontend initial API loads use bare promises without catch/error state, so API failures can leave indefinite loading or stale empty screens.
Several interactive SelectItem controls lack data-testid, reducing deterministic testability despite the stated testing contract.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested desktop functional flows passed; mobile layout failed design review)

seed_data_creation: Reset to deterministic seed data. Temporary TEST_ target/deal/contact/doc records were cleaned. Final backend suite added 5 deterministic signals and successful agent-run audit records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 because the session seed fixture is destructive and pytest.ini enables xdist; parallel workers race POST /api/admin/seed. Desktop UI passed dashboard bars/ingestion, targets/detail/scoring/agents, kanban stage gates/new deal/note, contacts waterfall/draft, signals/graph, VDR, agent console, and gateway. Initial UI assertion/wait failures were corrected and were not product defects.
rca_of_the_issue: Backend failures are caused by missing existence checks/matched_count handling in create_deal, update_contact, and set_access. Mobile failure is caused by Layout.jsx using an unconditional w-[236px] sticky sidebar with no responsive collapse, leaving a 154px main region at a 390px viewport.
